description: Consolidate ALL story status into RUNBOOK.md so it is genuinely the complete single source of truth (Option A). Add the 10 Floor & Harvest stories (A.1-A.4, B.1, C.1-C.5) to the RUNBOOK as a separate labeled track, add detail-index entries for the started (done) F&H stories A.1-A.4, update the RUNBOOK intro/how-to-read note to state it tracks pipeline + governance + F&H work, and demote docs/governance/FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md section 4 table to non-authoritative (pointer to RUNBOOK) while preserving all its narrative. This is a re-org/consolidation only: NO story status, dependency, completed date, or restore tag is changed. Also apply a test-only fix to scripts/test_check_docs.py to repair a PRE-EXISTING CHECK B test failure (the register is empty on main so CHECK B cannot fire) without weakening the CHECK B rule, so the full test suite passes after the change. Work on branch docs/runbook-consolidate-abc off main (642fc7f). This is a single coherent unit of work.
steps: Create and switch to branch docs/runbook-consolidate-abc from main: `git checkout -b docs/runbook-consolidate-abc` (repo /projects/sandbox/ZTIE-Issues, currently on main at 642fc7f).

RUNBOOK.md - intro/how-to-read: Update the opening banner blockquote (the 'Living progress ledger' paragraph near the top) AND the '> How to read this table.' note under the master table to plainly state the RUNBOOK now tracks ALL work: the numbered pipeline stories, the governance (G) stories, AND the Floor & Harvest (A/B/C) transition track. One or two plain-language sentences for a non-technical reader. AVOID em dashes in the new prose (use hyphens).

RUNBOOK.md - add F&H track table: Inside the '## Build order (dependency-driven)' area, AFTER the existing master table (and its 'How to read this table' note, before or after the '### Phase gates (retained)' subsection - place it as a new '### Floor & Harvest track (A/B/C - transition to the component archive)' subsection). Give it its OWN pipe table whose header PRESERVES the checker-parseable leading-column signature the master table uses: 'Build tier | Story | Title | Depends on | Status | Restore tag' (keep the 'Build tier' column but put a non-numeric value like 'F&H' for these rows; you may omit Phase/Completed columns since these are not phase-bound, but you MUST keep the Story, Title, Depends on, and Status columns present and keep the emoji in the Status cell). Add all 10 rows copying Title, Depends on, Status emoji, and Restore tag VERBATIM from FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md section 4. You MAY trim the long inline notes in the Title cells to a concise phrase to fit a table cell, but do NOT change status, dependency, or restore tag. The 10 rows and their VERBATIM statuses: A.1 (deps -, ✅ done, restore '(folded into A.4 PR)'), A.2 (deps '2.0 built', ✅ done, restore `restore/story-2.0-green`), A.3 (deps '2.1 ✅', ✅ done, restore '(folds into floor)'), A.4 (deps 'A.1, A.2', ✅ done, restore `restore/phase-2-floor-green`), B.1 (deps A.4, ⬜ not started, restore '(docs)'), C.1 (deps B.1, ⬜ not started, restore 'archive v0.1.0+'), C.2 (deps C.1, ⬜ not started, restore 'archive tag per construct'), C.3 (deps A.4, ⬜ not started, restore `restore/shared-seam-green`), C.4 (deps C.2, ⬜ not started, restore `restore/migrate-<stack>-green`), C.5 (deps C.4, ⬜ not started, restore '(docs)'). Add a short intro sentence above the table noting these A/B/C stories are the readiness-sequenced transition track (not part of the numeric pipeline dependency DAG) and that full narrative lives in docs/governance/FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md.

RUNBOOK.md - detail index: In the '### Detail index (started stories)' section, add bold story-ID paragraphs for the started (done) F&H stories A.1, A.2, A.3, A.4 (in ID order, after the existing pipeline/G entries or interleaved consistently - simplest is to append an A.1..A.4 block after 2.1 / before or after G-3, keeping the section coherent). Each entry: '**A.1** (Done) - <1-2 sentence plain-language summary accurate to the FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN notes>. Full detail: [Floor & Harvest Plan](docs/governance/FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md).' Link to FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md (NOT docs/STORY_DETAIL.md, since A/B/C are not in STORY_DETAIL.md). Do NOT add B.1 or C.x (they are not started - table-only, consistent with not-started pipeline stories). Summaries must be accurate: A.1 = re-applied the capture-tooling Phase-2 target extension onto latest main via the A.4 PR (the stale branch was intentionally not merged to avoid reverting governance state); A.2 = validated Story 2.0 live in Forensic (all 7 DoD checks passed 2026-09-02) and flipped it done, tag restore/story-2.0-green; A.3 = confirmed Story 2.1 is done on main (no re-run) and folded it into the floor; A.4 = instituted deployed-state restore points (captured + verify-clean manifests for both Hub and Forensic accounts, filled BOM's 11 pending rows), tag restore/phase-2-floor-green. AVOID em dashes in the new prose.

docs/governance/FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md - demote section 4 table: In the '## 4. Stories' section, ADD a clear pointer note (a blockquote) directly above or below the status table stating that status for the A/B/C stories is now tracked in RUNBOOK.md (the single source of truth) and this table is retained for narrative/dependency reference only, no longer authoritative for status. KEEP the table and ALL other narrative (sections 0-3, 5, 6 the 2.0 live-validation runbook, 7 sequence, 8) fully intact. Do NOT delete any narrative value. Do NOT change any status/facts in the table. AVOID em dashes in the new prose.

scripts/test_check_docs.py - test-only fix for the PRE-EXISTING CHECK B failure: The test test_new_feature_started_while_debt_open_fires_check_b currently FAILS on main because the Validation Debt Register is EMPTY (2.0 cleared), and CHECK B early-returns when the register is empty, so no CHECK B violation can fire. Fix the test (test code ONLY, do NOT weaken check_docs.py or its CHECK B rule) so it seeds a non-empty register in its fixture before flipping 2.2 to done: e.g. add a helper that inserts a story row (a plausible open-debt entry) into the copied RUNBOOK's Validation Debt Register table so CHECK B is armed, then assert CHECK B fires for 2.2 as before. Ensure test_clean_tree_passes and test_unregistered_in_progress_fires_check_a still pass. Do NOT change the assertions' intent (CHECK B must still fire for a new started feature while debt is open). If a simpler in-place register mutation keeps all three tests green and isolated, use that.
Run ruff on any changed Python: `ruff check scripts/` and fix any lint from the test edit.

Commit on branch docs/runbook-consolidate-abc with a clear message (e.g. 'docs: consolidate Floor & Harvest A/B/C stories into RUNBOOK as complete single-source ledger; demote FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN table to narrative; repair pre-existing CHECK B test'). Stage specific files: RUNBOOK.md, docs/governance/FLOOR_AND_HARVEST_PLAN.md, scripts/test_check_docs.py (and .agents/ if desired). Do NOT push.
